messages:
Alex: Morning team — async pipeline check. What I did: ran demo with MacroHealth, sent Dedicated pricing. Blockers: legal asks for on-prem network diagram + HSM details. Today: follow up with infra + propose timeline. @Maria can you share the sanitized VPC diagram you used for Kestrel?

Maria: Yep, I'll drop the public diagram and a minimal config snippet. For KMS/HSM we handed them the KMS flow + key-wrap RFC earlier.

Devon: Infra note: private control plane needs a small mTLS patch for customer KMS; pairing with eng-runtime today to scope. ETA ~48h if all good.

Kevin: MacroHealth expects SLA around 99.9 for p50/p95. We can guarantee p50; p95 depends on Dedicated benchmarking. Flagged to product.

Tia: Infosec asked: "how are model artifacts protected at rest in Dedicated vs Private?" Short answer: AES-256 + customer-managed keys via KMS/HSM; on-prem disk encryption optional. @sec-bot paste standard blurb?

sec-bot: Standard security blurb: "Model artifacts and logs are encrypted at rest using AES-256; customers may supply keys via KMS/HSM integrations. For Private deployments, customers retain control of key material and network boundaries; audit logs can be forwarded to customer SIEM. See: https://redwood.example.com/security/enterprise#kms"

Alex: Maria — can you paste the sanitized config snippet showing control plane auth to customer KMS (mTLS + key-wrap)?

Maria: Snippet (sanitized):

```
control_plane:
  auth:
    method: mTLS
    client_cert: /etc/redwood/certs/client.pem
    key_wrap: aws:kms:arn:... or hsm:slot:1
network:
  allowed_cidrs: [10.0.0.0/16]
```

Diagram: https://files.redwood.example.com/diagrams/vpc-kms-public.png :thumbsup:

Devon: If they require HSM on-prem, customer must open TCP port 1792 from control plane to HSM and provide certs. Adding to checklist.

Kevin: Also confirm FIPS requirement. If FIPS enabled, expect small perf impact on quantized models.

Alex: Action items: 1) Maria send sanitized diagram + config to MacroHealth legal/infosec. 2) Devon share port/cert checklist + ETA. 3) Kevin coordinate p95 benchmark and FIPS note. I'll follow up with the customer.

Maria: Emailed diagrams to legal (cc Alex).

Devon: Opened infra ticket INF-4821; will post branch once ready.

Kevin: Created product benchmark request PROD-BENCH-129; will update by EOD.

Tia: One more ask: short blurb on EU data residency for hybrid customers.

Maria: Blurb: "Redwood Private supports EU region provisioning and data residency controls. Hosted data can be restricted to EU regions; Dedicated instances can be deployed in customer-chosen regions. See: https://redwood.example.com/compliance/data-residency"

Alex: OK closing loop after Devon + Kevin updates. Add quick replies here. :rocket:
